card.name: Decimal point inside numbers
card.fires_on: The period between digits in a decimal number or section number, such as 5.4, 7.2 or 0.6. It is strongest in cross-reference lists of section numbers and in dose ranges.

modes.description: The dot in a section number inside parentheses, often in a list of references.

modes.label: Decimals in values
modes.description: The decimal point inside a measured value or range.
